name: Spell Lore: Wardens of the Chorrileum

spells.name: Slipstream
spells.effect: The target can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Chorrileum Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Chorrileum^^** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Essence of the Chorrileum
spells.effect: If the target is **^^Namarti^^**, you can return D6 slain models to it. Otherwise, **Heal (D3)** the target.
spells.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Chorrileum Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Chorrileum^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
